rows.grounds: śāsanasthān = those standing in the teaching (m.acc.pl. of śāsanastha); purājātyā = by former birth (f.inst.sg. of purājāti)
paśyet = should regard (3sg.opt.act. √dṛś); na api = nor; udīrayet = should mention (3sg.opt.act. √ud-īr)
vyavaharet = should deal with (3sg.opt.act. √vi-avahṛ); sarvān = all (m.acc.pl. of sarva); śivābhedena = as non-different from Śiva (m.inst.sg. of śivābheda, compound śiva+abheda)
